bandReport.notes: Printed pages 43, 45, 47, 49, 51 — the last five English pages of the booklet. Two column-straddles, both resolved by column flow: p42 Q99's stem ends the left column and its four options open the right; p44 Q104's two statements end the left column and its code block opens the right. Q120 completes at the foot of p50's right column and the paper ends there, so the booklet is confirmed at 120 items from the page rather than from the config constant; PDF pages 51-54 are rough work in both languages and 55 is the back cover. Q97-Q105 are Current Affairs and Economics; Q106-Q120 are an unbroken Biology block. Q116's stem is printed with no closing question mark, and Q95's '?' after a statement is the same compositor habit; transcribed as printed.
